checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Four separate square slides with names in order
must.why: Four 640px squares: Monstera, Snake Plant, Pothos, Peace Lily in order.
Monstera has split leaves, snake plant has upright leaves, pothos has heart leaves with trailing vines, peace lily has white spathes. The monstera's splits are shallow but visible.
All four use the same green and cream linocut look.
Same double border, serif bold lettering, paper texture and banded pot on every slide. Small differences in the pot rim and cream tone are minor.

must.item: Only plant and name change; aligned and readable
must.why: Layout and pot position match across slides and all names are readable. The pothos fills more of the frame than the others.

faults.what: Names are in Title Case ('Snake Plant', 'Peace Lily'), not the lowercase second word the user wrote. This is a normal capitalisation choice.
The pothos is busy and looks a bit like a generic leafy plant. Its vines are short and its leaves are crowded.
The cream background tone varies slightly between slides, and the pot rim differs slightly.
Output is only 640px, so it is soft.

summary: Four consistent sage-and-cream linocut slides with correct names and recognisable plants; only small variations in cream tone, pot detail and pothos density."
